_head.js:
Opens the one closure the whole app runs in. Everything in src/app shares this scope: a top-level function in any file can call one in any other.
Flow: the browser runs this script last; the closure body runs top to bottom in manifest order (constants and closures first, listeners as they come, boot/init.js last).
_tail.js: Closes the app closure (the test build puts src/test/hooks.js right before this).
kit/tooltip-words.js:
The words of every tooltip: tipNorm(raw, ctx) rewrites a raw title into the house style (what it does, then the key; sentence case; no “Click to”), with TIPMAP for exact phrases and TIPPAT for patterns.
Flow: kit/tooltip-engine.js calls window.tipNorm for every title / data-tip it shows; build/checks/tooltips.py runs every static tooltip through the same function.
kit/px-kit.js:
The px- kit every page stands on: pxI icons, keyboard chips (pxKbd/pxKeys), switches and segments (pxSw/pxSeg), relative time (pxAgo), and PX_STATUS — the one status list (name, tone, who moves it) with pxSt / pxPartIn / pxPartKeys.
Flow: pure helpers; no state, no listeners.
kit/status-look.js:
One status look on every page (Parsec 14): pgSt(kind, value) draws a status as icon + word in its tone, from PGST_RO / PGST_PART / PGST_CLAIM; pgStMap/pgStKey normalize the many old spellings.
Flow: every list and pill calls pgSt instead of building its own markup.
kit/tooltip-texts.js:
What a status pill, an avatar or a main action says when you point at it (Parsec 14.9 E): who set a status and when (V149E stamps saved on the record), what a part is waiting on, the Technician lane's words.
Flow: pgStTip / v149eAvTip build the text; v149eStamp records who changed a status at save time (automations/watcher.js calls it).
kit/tooltip-engine.js:
The tooltip component (Parsec 14.9 A): one Ink tooltip with an arrow for every title / data-tip, and for text that is cut off by an ellipsis. PTIP holds it; its mode (on / icons only / off) is a setting.
Flow: document-level pointer and focus listeners find the nearest element with a title (findT) or cut text (findCut), ask tipNorm for the words, place the tip, and hide it on leave / scroll / key.
kit/icons.js: The sidebar's stroke icons: sfIcon() draws one from the SF set; NAV_ICONS maps page → icon.
kit/icons-3d.js:
The layered colour icons (I3) for the big touch mode and the theme / zoom helpers that came with them: zoom factor, big-touch class, theme labels, the Ctrl K palette's result rows.
Flow: i3(name) builds an icon from layers; applyBigTouch sets the <html> class the CSS keys off.
kit/constants.js: Shared constants: the clock-in / clock-out reasons and their colours, job type labels, the font link; small helpers that read them (reasonVar, opJobType).
kit/formatters.js: Formatting helpers used everywhere: hours as h:mm:ss / h:mm / decimals, percentages, dates, and esc() for HTML.
kit/colors.js: One colour per clock reason and per job type, everywhere (Parsec 12.3): jtVar / truckCfg / truckLine, and the sidebar's four-swatch theme strip (pxThemeStrip).
kit/legacy-helpers.js: Small helpers left from the Parsec 8 console that pages still call: effBar (the efficiency bar), the attachments folder name, copyText, addLogEntry, recalcLive.
state/state.js:
The two roots: STATE (everything the shop keeps — ROs, punches, staff, settings; saved to the folder) and UI (what this screen is showing — view, selection, open pop-overs; saved per browser). Plus the save timer and sync status.
Flow: pages read STATE, change it through an action, call render(); scheduleSave() writes it. Server seam: STATE is the whole document a server would hold.
state/folder-fs.js: The File System Access handle to the shop folder (FS.dir) and the IndexedDB slot that remembers it between visits.
state/folder-layout.js:
Names and paths inside Parsec Data/: the root, each RO's folder and page name, safe file names, the shop files; roFolderFor / roPageName are the single place that spells them.
Flow: data/store-*.js call these when reading and writing; nothing else builds a path by hand.
state/ro-page-file.js: The readable Repair Order page written beside each RO's data (roPageHtml) and the shop page (shopPageHtml): HTML a person can open and print; Parsec also reads its data block back.
state/migrate-to-parsec-data.js: One-time move of the old “ROs Data” + shop-data.json layout into Parsec Data/ (Parsec 9 era folders).
state/drafts.js:
Typed text survives a refresh: every text box's draft is kept (DRAFTS) and put back when the same field appears again, including an open modal.
Flow: input listeners store by draftKey; draftsRestore runs after a render.
state/undo.js: The Undo stack (UNDO, UNDO_MAX). pushUndo (ro/actions.js) snapshots STATE before a change; undoLast puts it back.
state/data-safety.js: Guards around the data (round 25): burnt hours re-derived from punches (syncAllBurnt), clashing punches, Undo snapshots as JSON, the local-day cache, and restoring a backup file (restoreBackup / summarizeState).
data/folder-gate.js:
The shop folder comes first: before sign-in, Parsec asks for the folder (fsGateHtml) and says in words what went wrong (fsWhy). FS_LOCAL lets the tests and a quick look run without one.
Flow: boot/init.js calls restoreFolder(); until FS_READY the gate renders instead of the app.
data/clean.js:
Data that travels cleanly (Parsec 16 B): one form for every field — ISO dates, YYYY-MM-DD days, dollars as numbers (cents in the export), slim Completed records; v160CleanOnce converts an older folder once (STATE.dataV).
Flow: adoptFolderState → v160CleanOnce; v160CleanAll is the one pass that knows every field.
data/photo-shrink.js: Photos wider than 1600 px or over 2 MB become a 1600 px JPEG before they are saved (v160Shrink); PDFs and small images stay as they are.
data/store-topics.js:
The data store's map (Parsec 16 A): PD_TOPICS says which Shop/<topic>.json holds which STATE keys, PD_SPLIT which are split by month or year, PD_HOME what lives with the ROs or in layout.json, PD_LOCAL_ONLY what stays on this computer. Also the small helpers (ids, hashes, canonical text).
Flow: build/checks/data_keys.py fails the build when a STATE key has no home here. Server seam: this map is the table list a server would mirror.
data/store-records.js:
Records and marks: where an RO's folder goes (Open / Closed/<year>), ids on every record, updatedAt / updatedBy marks, deletion marks (tombstones in STATE.tombs), and pdCanon — the same data always gives the same text.
Flow: pdMark is called by the save; the merge and the export rely on ids and marks.
data/store-read-write.js: Reading and writing layout 16: pd16Read walks Parsec Data/ into a state; pd16Write writes only what changed (ROs by folder, the shop by topic, big topics by month), compressing Closed years.
data/store-merge.js:
Merging two states record by record (two computers saved the same shop): newer mark wins, deletions carry, and a clash on the same record asks Keep this / Keep that (pdClashAsk).
Flow: adoptFolderState and pd16Poll call pdMerge; pdApplyMerge writes the result.
data/store-save-open.js:
The save and the open: writeFolderState → pd16Save (debounced, only changed files); readFolderState; adoptFolderState merges what the folder has with what is in memory; the one-time move from layout 15 (backup → write → read back → compare → tidy), the Parsec 15 safety net, and the poll for another computer's saves.
Flow: scheduleSave() → writeFolderState(); connectFolder() → adoptFolderState().
data/store-api.js: What the rest of the app asks the store for: pdRoDir / pdAttList for an RO's folder and attachments, pd16Info and the banner on Your data, writeFileToFolder, and the Parsec 15 writers kept for the migration.
data/store-helpers.js: Small store helpers with no installs: gzip / gunzip through the browser's CompressionStream, SHA-256 checksums, folder lookups (pdDirAt / pdPut), timestamps.
data/backups.js:
Backups: one compressed copy of everything at the end of the working day in Backups/<YYYY-MM>/ (keep 30), and Back up now from Your data.
Flow: pdBkTick runs on a timer; pdBackupNow writes data-<date>.json.gz.
data/export.js:
Export for the server: every table as JSONL (tables/*.jsonl), attachments copied, schema.json, README.txt and a manifest with SHA-256 per file. Money goes out in cents, links as ids.
Flow: pdExport builds the tables from STATE with pdBuildTables; pdxRow flattens one record. Server seam: this is the import format for a server.
data/import-export.js: Reading an export back: verify every checksum (refuse on a mismatch), import it, and the round-trip check that compares an export with the live state (pdxDiff).
shell/render-root.js:
render(): the one place the page is drawn. It picks the view, builds its HTML, morphs it into #app, then runs each area's after-render hooks. histSync keeps the browser history in step.
Flow: every change ends in render(); pages never touch the DOM outside their own after() hooks.
shell/design-system.js: The Ivory / Graphite shell: the sidebar (ivSideHtml), its mini form, the case rules, the page header (pzHeaderHtml), the IVI stroke icon set.
shell/nav-rail.js: The nav rail: one column, every icon in the same box; PX_GROUPS orders the pages; the narrow (folded) state, the clock row, and who is signed in.
shell/nav-arrange.js: Arranging the side bar: press and hold a page, then drag; a switch hides a page (the name menu keeps it); the shop’s order (the manager) and each person’s own.
shell/dept-tabs.js: Time Log and Career as tabs on each department page: the title becomes the tabs; the department they sit on (UI.dHome); who gets Career.
shell/widths.js: Widths you set by dragging: the side bar's edge, the panes (lists, the RO list's side panel, the Library's document panel); the folded side bar opens on hover over its expand button.
shell/smooth-scroll.js: Smooth scrolling everywhere: a mouse wheel's steps glide on the page and in every scrolling pane (the RO page's too); touchpads, zoom and reduced motion are left alone.
shell/motion-open.js: Everything that opens, closes or switches moves: what closes fades out where it was, a fold eases the section to its new height, a tab or page eases in.
shell/rail-popovers.js: The two pop-overs off the rail (the clock, the person) and the tooltip mode row (PTIP_MODES / ptipSetMode).
shell/event-wiring.js:
The app's main click / change / input / drop handlers on document: data-action buttons are dispatched here to the function that does the work (the big switch), plus drag-and-drop of files and the keyboard shortcuts that are the same everywhere.
Flow: a button carries data-action="…"; the handler reads it, calls the action, and the action calls render().
shell/live-time.js: The second-by-second tick: tickLive patches only the figures that move (clocks, elapsed), never a full render while you are typing (safeToRedraw).
shell/modals.js: modalHtml: the app's pop-up dialogs drawn from UI.modal (new RO, edit punch, PIN, reasons, backups, …) and the small date helpers they share.
shell/ro-rail.js:
The RO list rail beside the RO page (shown / hidden, widths) and, since 16.3, roLnk(): every RO number anywhere becomes a link that opens its RO, with the picture and the ⋯ shop menu on RO rows (rl163Deco runs on every render).
Flow: patchApp calls rl163Deco(tmp) before the morph, so links are part of the markup, not patched after.
shell/motion.js: The micro-interactions (Parsec 10): MI holds what is animating; pmBeforeRender / pmAfterRender glide cards between renders; pmStageNotice flashes a stage.
shell/lists-fold.js: Every page's left list folds to a strip (Parsec 12.7): LF remembers it per page, lfDecorate adds the « button after a render.
shell/page-search.js: The page search window (Ctrl K and each page's search icon): PSM finds ROs, people and parts, draws the results, and jumps to one (psmPick).
shell/key-sheet.js: The ? key sheet: one list of the keys that work everywhere, then the page's own (pxKeyGroups).
shell/device-mode.js: Computer or phone view: Automatic picks from the device, or the person sets it (DEVICE_SETTING); applyDevice sets data-device on <html>.
shell/day-ribbon.js: The slim live strip across the top of every page: today's punches, air and the clock state.
shell/header-shrink.js: The top bar shrinks on scroll and grows back (syncHeaderShrink on window scroll).
access/sign-in.js: Who is using this computer (not a password): pxOut / pxSignedIn, the sign-in state in localStorage (tec_viewas), and the login page's data (lgStaff, lgClk).
access/login-page.js: The login page: one tile per person, the running clocks, the shop name.
access/pin-pad.js: The PIN pad: open for a person, draw, keys and clicks, the first-time PIN, and sign in when it matches (lgSignIn).
access/lock-screen.js: Stepping away: the lock screen (lgLockNow / lgUnlock), switching person from the lock, and the quick switcher off your name (lgMeMenu).
access/idle-and-end-of-day.js: The clock on the login page, the idle check (nobody touching it → lock) and the end of the shop day.
access/permissions.js:
Who can do what: roles, each person's pages and actions, can(action) / canPage(page), the Admin's changes per person (permSet) and the sync of pages when a role changes.
Flow: every page asks can() before showing a button; access/guards.js refuses the function itself. Server seam: these are the rules a server would enforce.
access/pins.js: PINs: salted SHA-256, never kept as typed (pinHash / pinValid), temporary PINs shown once, the Admin PIN.
access/guards.js:
The guards on the shared functions (Parsec 13): setRoStatus, doStartPunch, deletePunch… are wrapped so a role that may not do it is refused with a toast before any page sees the click; permRootSync puts one class per missing action on <html> so the button is not even drawn.
Flow: runs at load, wrapping the functions in place — keep this file after the functions it wraps in the manifest.
access/people-and-demo-team.js: People: staffList() and lookups by name / role (staffForTech, techNorm), initials and avatars (avatarSvg), the audit log (audit / auditLog), and the demo team used by the sample data.
access/portraits.js: Portraits for the demo team: staffPhotoUrl picks a drawn or uploaded picture; PHOTO_MAP keeps what was chosen.
access/admin-helpers.js: Admin's shared actions (also used by Manager → Team): add a person, reset a PIN, turn sign-in off, show a temporary PIN once.
access/admin-page/_open.js: Opens the Admin page closure (ADMPG): people and what each can do.
access/admin-page/admin-page.js:
The Admin page: people (role, pages, actions per person), roles, sign-in rules, the sign-in log, the add-a-person pop; H() handles its clicks.
Flow: view() draws from staffList() and the permission tables; changes go through permSet / permRoleSet and audit.
access/admin-page/person-page.js: One person’s page on Admin › People (17.3): the name, role and what’s changed from it, the Sign-in card, and tabs for Pages (tiles), What they can do (Role · On · Off, ↺ per row) and Activity; a role change says first what it adds and takes away.
access/admin-page/view.js: viewAdmin(): the page module's entry, called by render().
ro/lookups.js: Finding things: getRO(id), the Shop RO (shop time), prices and money per part / operation / RO.
ro/derived-calcs.js: Numbers derived from an operation: opCalc (quoted, burnt, left, efficiency), part locks (a repair that waits on a part), what is missing to complete (opCompleteGaps), the operation's status from its fields (opStatus / opStatusRaw).
ro/forecast.js: When will this RO be ready: roForecast asks the RO engine (window.RoMath, src/engine/ro-engine.js) with the shop calendar, each tech's pace and parts' ETAs.
ro/stages.js: The six RO stages (Check-in → Close-out), each with one “done when” rule; roStages(ro) says where an RO stands, stageToggle checks one off by hand.
ro/ro-panel.js: The one RO side panel's shared pieces: the stage line, Time · Parts · Files on one line, the operations, the buttons by role, and the folds each person keeps.
ro/assist.js: The RO assist strip: the next step, burnt vs quoted, the story so far (raNext / raStory) — shown on the Triage and Technician panes.
ro/route.js: The RO's route between departments: who holds it now (writer, tech, parts, foreman…), the next step for a role (rtNext / rtStepFor).
ro/transfers.js: Transfers: a hand-off the other side has to accept (rtSend / rtAccept / rtReturn), hold goals per holder (rtCfg), the log and how long each hold took.
ro/cause-correction.js: Cause and Correction from the tech notes (17.3): the notes split into sentences, the first half the Cause and the rest the Correction, a sentence moved by hand, saved on the operation for Warranty and Fixes.
ro/ordering.js: How ROs sort: last touched, finished, days open; sortedROs(); pillHtml for the fast-punch pill.
ro/task-bulletins.js: The hours on an RO: quoted, burnt, remaining, efficiency (roQuotedHours…), the engine's daily calc with shifts and holes, and the bulletin kinds an RO's log can hold (WF_TASKS).
ro/warnings.js: Warnings and reminders computed from the data (computeWarningsAll / computeRemindersAll) and the dismissals remembered against what each notice is about.
ro/actions.js:
The actions that change an RO or a clock: doStartPunch / doStopPunch, status flips, pushToast (with Undo while it is still the last change), migrateRO for old records, Parsec 14.8's Declined start.
Flow: an action changes STATE, pushUndo first, scheduleSave after, render(); the automations watcher sees the change at save.
ro/flow-gates.js: The RO flow's soft gates (Parsec 14.1): Done asks instead of refusing (gaps), starting an unapproved operation asks, a truck back within days asks “a comeback?”, the RO waits on parts only when every open operation does, one release list; pgAsk is the shared question dialog.
ro/details-table.js: The RO's details as one table (ROFLD): every field with its label, how it shows, how it is set, who may edit; roFldSet is the one setter (Undo, the value, an Activity line, save). The truck card, the RO list pane and the import all draw from it.
ro/truck-card-words.js: The truck card's words that change in place (Parsec 14.2): year / make / model / unit, the key tag beside the spot (14.9 D), quoted hours edited inline (qtEdit).
ro/road-test-and-release.js: Road test before release (a switch per RO), what “work done” means, the stage label shown for a status (roStageInfo / pgStRo).
ro/reopen-question.js: The question when a completed RO is set back to open: reopen its operations too, or just the RO.
ro/toasts-and-spots.js: Automation toasts that name the RO (v14AutoToast), spots by their code; the staff photo overrides from Parsec 14 (B).
ro-page/_css.js: The RO page's own stylesheet, JC_CSS — it renders in a shadow root, so its CSS is a string. The files are styles/ro-page/*.css; the build joins them into this constant.
ro-page/icons.js: The icon set the RO page uses (IC) and tecRender(), the RO page's way to ask the app to redraw.
ro-page/job-road.js: The job road: the small animated scene under an open job card (truck, road, sky by time of day) — RD_SCENES and the SVG builders; ROAD_CSS is appended to JC_CSS.
ro-page/_open.js: Opens the RO page closure, JC (“job console”). Everything inside is the RO page: one RO, its operations, parts, time, files and header. R is its shadow root, RO the open RO, S its per-RO state.
ro-page/constants.js: The RO page's constants: job types, status looks, task kinds.
ro-page/helpers.js: DOM and format helpers local to the RO page (el, svg, hm, hms, uid…) and the attachment store in IndexedDB for files not yet in the folder.
ro-page/state.js:
The RO page's state: R (shadow root), HOST, RO, S (per-RO UI state: open card, tabs, selection), mounting into the app's page, and the small date conversions.
Flow: ensureHost() creates the shadow host once; render() (ro-page/render.js) draws RO into it.
ro-page/builders.js: Small builders: fields, dropdowns, the pop-over pinning (a pop-over stays put while the page redraws), live updaters for totals.
ro-page/render-header.js: The RO header band: compact or open, Details, delete RO.
ro-page/bulletins.js: Files on the RO: saving to the folder (or IndexedDB until there is one), shrinking images, thumbnails, the bulletin log entries that carry files.
ro-page/task-bar.js: Clock-string parsing for the time fields and the punch story builder.
ro-page/job-cards.js: The operation cards: the efficiency bar, the start / stop reason questions, the complete gate, the drag order, glide between renders.
ro-page/extract-operations.js: Extract operations into this RO from pasted text or a screenshot (Parsec 14.8 B): complaint, status, quoted time and approval only; matched to existing operations before anything is added.
ro-page/open-operation.js: The open operation card: the clock bar, part tiles with status and ETA, the job log; setPartStatus and the Receive all / Install all actions.
ro-page/summary-and-selection.js: The work performed as one paragraph for warranty / triage (complaint, cause, correction), and the selection toolbar for marking text as a pill.
ro-page/page-helpers.js: Helpers the RO page's renderers share: operation state chips, parts arrived checks, dropping files on a job, visit words, similar jobs.
ro-page/fault-codes.js: Fault codes on each operation (SPN / FMI, P-codes): reading what was typed, what a code means, the chips on the tile and the card, and the note a chip starts; Add ▾ for a code, a document or the Library (17.1).
ro-page/op-tiles.js: The operation tiles on the RO page: one row of tiles with their states (to do, live, held, selected, done), the progress strip, and P to quick-add a part.
ro-page/op-card.js: The open operation card (jobCard): header, body, parts, the day strip and rail, the metrics and the quote; built fresh on every render.
ro-page/totals.js: The RO totals row and the day strip under it.
ro-page/toolbar.js: The RO toolbar: tabs, the job stepper and job dots, files on the RO (allFiles / addFilesToRO), late parts.
ro-page/attachments-view.js: The attachments large view: list, keys, rename, delete, open.
ro-page/modal-export-print.js: The RO page's modal, and export / import / print of one RO (sheetFromRO, importSheet).
ro-page/render.js:
The RO page's render: openState (which card is open), renderNow draws every part into the shadow root, flipCards animates, and the scroll / pin bookkeeping.
Flow: the app's render() → JC.render() when the RO page is the view; nothing else draws into R.
ro-page/ivory.js: The Ivory / Graphite look on the RO page: ivOn, the operation side panel, clockCalm.
ro-page/px-components.js: The RO page's components from the Parsec design system: pop-overs (one at a time, fixed to the viewport), the modal with scrim, StatusMenu, PartStatus dropdown, the Transfer / Add operation / Delete dialogs.
ro-page/header-page.js: The RO page header (pxHeader): breadcrumb with the RO number (click copies it), the pager, the customer and contact with its menu (16.3 B), the counters (hours, parts, files), the options menu.
ro-page/layout.js: The RO page in your layout (Parsec 12): the one-panel page — operations in the middle, the truck card and the sections on the right (ROPS), who is on it, the right column's fit.
ro-page/release-bypass.js: The RO page's Release button (it opens Release, which asks why while checks are open) and the line an older RO released without checks still shows.
ro-page/declined.js: Declined on the operation's status menu (14.8 A) and the complaint edited in place while the clock runs or not.
ro-page/time-tab.js: An open operation's Time tab: every punch from its start to its stop, typed times, stops, the day bar; Parsec 15's notes that are not on a punch.
ro-page/tab-actions.js: Each tab's actions at the right of the tabs: attach, paste a screenshot, the notes paragraph to copy (Time), add a part (Parts).
ro-page/operation-header.js: The operation row (17.1: the number, the complaint and the status, a blocker beside it, the job type its coloured edge), the status and job type menus, the ⋯ menu (rename, delete), and the open card's body with its facts.
ro-page/picking.js: Picking several operations or parts at once on the RO page: the selection, the bulk actions, the pick toolbar.
ro-page/build-and-fold.js: ropBuild draws the RO page's sections in order; every section folds (Parsec 14.4) and remembers it.
ro-page/collapse-expand.js: Collapse all / Expand all on the sections below the operations (Parsec 15), one switch.
ro-page/clock-card-model.js: The operation clock card (Parsec 12.4 / 12.5), the model: the numbers each page counts (ockModel), the shop day, similar jobs and the tech's usual pace, parts on the job, the punches' notes (and each note's time, p.noteAt) and splits.
ro-page/clock-card-draw.js: The clock card's pieces, markup and ticker: the big time, the ring, segments and facts; focus mode (the big shop-floor view); ockTick updates every card in place each second; the time bar's initials and note pins, and the note added where you click (17.1).
ro-page/clock-card-actions.js: What you do on the clock card: hold to stop with a reason, lap / split, fix the start, notes, reopen; ockAuto for lunch and the end of the day (reminders only since Parsec 15).
ro-page/one-ro-view.js: One RO view (14.3 B): the Technician page's middle and right are the RO page itself; TCX says when the RO page is embedded there.
import/new-ro/_open.js: Opens the New RO import closure (IMPX): paste the ASIST case page, or drop screenshots, and get an RO with its fields and operations.
import/new-ro/read-text.js:
Reading the pasted text: labels and cells, dates, money, names, the case fields (RO #, customer, VIN, unit…), operations with complaint / cause / correction, parts and amounts.
Flow: parse(text) → a fields object; everything else in new-ro works on that.
import/new-ro/field-rules.js: What each kind of value can hold (17.3): a number, a date, an amount or a part number can't hold letters, so the screenshot reader's O, l, I, S and B are put back as 0, 1, 5 and 8; a VIN is repaired with its check digit.
import/new-ro/read-checks.js: Checking what was read against itself (17.3): the VIN's model-year letter against the Year, dates in order, the RO number against the shop's others, hours against the labor price, a part's quantity and price against its line total.
import/new-ro/read-match.js: Matching what was read to what Parsec already knows (17.3): a customer spelled one letter off, the truck by its VIN or unit, a part number one character off a known one, what a fault code means.
import/new-ro/matching.js: Matching what was read to what the shop already has: the same RO (number, unit + customer), the same operation; merging a second paste into the first.
import/new-ro/fields.js: The RO's fields as rows of the dialog (SPEC: label, group, source), the operations' rows, what changed vs the existing RO.
import/new-ro/create.js: Create RO / Apply: setF writes each accepted field through the RO details table; operations and parts are added or updated.
import/new-ro/dialog-layout.js: The one extraction window's parts (17.3): the slim strip of files read, the Found line, the RO as a ticket, the list of things to check and the Check view, where everything goes (New RO, an open RO, Inventory, the Library), documents and photos, the footer.
import/new-ro/dialog.js: The import dialog: the field rows, operation cards, totals, notes, the last-contact suggestion (16.3), what is hidden until needed.
import/new-ro/open.js: Open and close the dialog, its input and key handling, the drag-and-drop of screenshots.
import/new-ro/_close.js: Closes the New RO import closure.
import/extract-operations.js: Extract operations and the Parts list import read every amount (Parsec 14): rows for operations and parts out of free text (x132OpsRows / parsePartsText).
import/case-import.js: The older case import (paste text / PDF): sentence case, VIN check, dates, the case fields and job rows (cj*) — the New RO import builds on these.
import/screenshot-reader.js:
The screenshot reader built into Parsec (no download): PSR renders the browser's own fonts as templates and reads text off a screenshot line by line (binarize → lines → glyphs → words).
Flow: ocrImages(files) → text → the same parse the paste uses.
import/contact-reading.js: The contact on New RO (16.3 C): contact name, phone (normalized), email, driver and driver's phone read from labels; the last contact used for the same customer / unit as a suggestion.
trucks/picture-data.js: The truck pictures: TRK_START (the data URLs — assets/trucks/*.webp, put in by the build), TRK_SEED (the four plain bodies), VT_P (the 52-truck catalog: model, years, cab, trims) and its indexes.
trucks/paint.js: The truck's colour (17.3): pick it in the Vehicle section; the catalog picture is repainted — the cab and hood only — on every page, from above too; kept with the truck by its VIN; never on a photo.
trucks/matching.js: Which picture an RO shows: trkPick — the RO's own picture, else the catalog body that matches its model and year (trkModelFor / trkMatch), else the check-in photo (trkPhotoOf); the library of pictures (trkLib) and their sources.
trucks/peek.js: The peek card on an RO link (16.3 B): after half a second on an RO number, the picture, customer, truck, status, tech and contact; click opens the RO.
trucks/ask-once.js: When an RO's first check-in photo arrives: ask once, model picture or this photo (ro.trkUse); plus trkHead / trkGi, the picture in a page header or list row.
trucks/banner-and-menu.js: The truck banner on the RO page (the title on the left, the truck on the right), the camera menu (add, change, remove a picture), the list thumbnail (trkThumb) and the Your data › Truck pictures settings.
trucks/truck-and-photos.js: Truck & photos: one window per RO from the camera button — the model list, the body picked, photos and receipts (TD).
trucks/catalog-window.js: The 52-truck catalog window: every body by year, pick one for the RO.
trucks/notes-on-truck.js: Notes on the truck (Parsec 9.9): put a note where the issue is on the RO's truck picture; TI holds the open inspector.
pages/frame.js:
The shared frame for the page modules (PG): icons (its own IC set), small formatters, people lookups, the module registry (PG.mods, reg / modOf / homeOf) and the shop's settings (labor rate, pay period).
Flow: each page closure registers itself with PG.reg; render() finds the view's module through PG.mods.
pages/shop-data.js: pgShopData(): the shop's numbers for Manager and Career — one pass over ROs, punches and day clocks, cached until the state changes.
pages/shared-yard.js: The yard shared by Foreman, Manager and Triage: spots, lines, the map, where each RO is (spotOf / onYard), auto-placing arrivals.
pages/technician/_open.js: Opens the Console / Technician closure (CX): the Console page (your day) and the Technician page (Parsec 11) share it.
pages/technician/console-model.js: The Console's model: your work read out of STATE for the person signed in — holds, notes, fixes, photos, the day's stats, the team.
pages/technician/console-draw.js: The Console's drawing: your work on the left, the operation on the right, the shop view (team and ROs by stage), its pop-overs.
pages/technician/technician-page.js: The Technician page (Parsec 11): the repair orders pane on the left (lanes, Completed since 14.7), the RO on the right (the RO page itself since 14.3).
pages/technician/picking-and-yard.js: On the Technician page: picking several operations, copy / print, the Time tab's punches, and the Yard (the shop floor and the lot) with its own view.
pages/technician/actions.js: What happens on the Technician page: Console's handlers aimed at the page, start / stop, notes, the camera, scans, its keys.
pages/technician/completed-list.js: Completed ROs kept per person (14.7 C): STATE.tcDone remembers the ROs a technician finished work on, even after transfer or delete.
pages/inbox/_open.js: Opens the Inbox closure (IB): only what is sent to you.
pages/inbox/model.js:
The Inbox's model: send(), the items for one person (stored notes plus what the shop derives: hand-offs, asks, reminders), threads, counts, the morning summary.
Flow: IB.send(to, item) is how every area tells a person something; IB.flush() runs after each render.
pages/inbox/draw.js: The Inbox's drawing: the list, one item, the thread detail, badges.
pages/inbox/actions.js: Doing things in the Inbox: select, settle, finish, send back, go to the page an item points at; typing and keys.
pages/timelog/_open.js: Opens the Time Log closure (TL): one person's day and pay period from the punches and day clocks.
pages/timelog/model.js: The Time Log's model: the day built from punches and day clocks (dayOf / calc), the pay period, evidence for an end time (14.6), fix requests → the foreman approves, Fix these items, deleted punches as air (15).
pages/timelog/draw.js: The Time Log's drawing: the day strip, the track, the drag layer, Fix these on top of the Day view, the sign bar, the pay-period and Shop views.
pages/timelog/popovers.js: The Time Log's pop-overs: a punch, a day clock, split / merge, the air reason, Move time.
pages/timelog/fixes.js: The fixes in one place (14.6): ACT (every fix action), runFix, ask (a request to the foreman), the reasons, drag to change a time.
pages/timelog/actions.js: Typing, dragging and keys on the Time Log; the delete question.
pages/timelog/view.js: viewTimeLog(): the page module's entry, called by render().
pages/parts/_open.js: Opens the Parts closure (PT): the parts desk — what each open RO needs from Parts.
pages/parts/model.js: The Parts page's model: the shop's parts settings, the catalog, the ROs as the parts desk sees them, what each needs (ordered / received / staged), returns.
pages/parts/draw.js: The Parts page's drawing: Desk, On order, Shelf, Returns, Catalog views, the selected RO and its parts.
pages/parts/popovers.js: The Parts page's pop-overs: order, ETA, find a part, send to.
pages/parts/actions.js: Doing things on the Parts page: order / receive / stage, tell the writer, send to the foreman, print; typing, scanning and keys.
pages/parts/stages.js: Parts stages on the Parts and Foreman pages (12.6): the step line Not ordered → Installed per RO, the part that holds the stage, Tell the tech.
pages/inventory/_open.js: Opens the Inventory page closure (INVPG): the parts stock.
pages/inventory/page-model.js: The Inventory page's model: sample stock seeded once, what the ROs still need, shelves, reorder and counts.
pages/inventory/draw.js: The Inventory page's drawing: the list, the pane for one part, reorder, count shelf by shelf, activity.
pages/inventory/actions.js: Doing things on the Inventory page: receive, move, count, reorder; typing and keys.
pages/inventory/model.js: The parts inventory itself (STATE.inventory): parts and kits with quantities, matching an RO's part to stock (invFind), syncing from operations.
pages/fixes/_open.js: Opens the Fixes closure (FX): every finished operation is a fix, grouped by complaint.
pages/fixes/model.js: The Fixes page's model: the shop's standards, quotes and aliases, the fixes built from finished operations, Review items.
pages/fixes/draw.js: The Fixes page's drawing: the library, one fix open (steps, parts, hours), Review.
pages/fixes/actions.js: Doing things on the Fixes page: Use fix, mark reviewed, copy; typing and keys.
pages/fixes/common-fixes.js: Common issues & fixes: fixes keyed by complaint across ROs (fixAll / fixTop); fixAutoFill does nothing since Parsec 9 (Use fix shows what changes).
pages/career/_open.js: Opens the Career closure (CR): one technician's own numbers and how they grow.
pages/career/engine.js: Career's engine: periods, windows, buckets and targets over pgShopData — every number below comes from these few functions.
pages/career/model.js: What a tech's Career keeps (STATE.cr[name]: rate, earlier years, goals) and the comparisons.
pages/career/draw.js: Career's drawing: overview tiles and charts, growth (bests, quotes), work (the ROs and operations).
pages/career/actions.js: Doing things on Career: pop-overs, clicks, the goal alerts sent to the Inbox.
pages/manager/_open.js: Opens the Manager closure (MG): the shop's KPIs from the ROs, the Time Log and Parts.
pages/manager/engine.js: Manager's engine: periods, windows, buckets, targets and deltas over pgShopData.
pages/manager/model.js: What the Manager page holds besides the numbers: pinned tiles, Needs you, hold goals, targets (mgSet).
pages/manager/draw.js: Manager's drawing: overview, the KPI list and one KPI, flow (who holds what), team, activity.
pages/manager/actions.js: Doing things on Manager: pop-overs, go to a KPI, clicks and keys.
pages/manager/ideas.js: The ten ideas (Manager v3): pace to month end, drivers, streaks, alerts, the monthly report.
pages/rolist/_open.js: Opens the RO list closure (RL): one flat list of ROs and a peek pane.
pages/rolist/model.js: The RO list's model: one RO as the list draws it (info, spot, next step), rows and counts.
pages/rolist/columns.js: The RO list's columns (13.1): drag into any order, add fields or your own, saved views, the Display pop-over.
pages/rolist/embed.js: The ROs tab on Triage, Foreman, Parts, Manager and Technician (14.3): rlEmbed puts the RO list inside another page, with Back.
pages/rolist/page-base.js: The RO list page's older base (RL_GROUPS, rlList) and the permission labels and role tables it shares with Admin (permRoles, permState…).
pages/report/_open.js: Opens the Day report closure (DR): the whole shop on one sheet.
pages/report/day-report.js: The Day report: every technician's day on one track, what to look at, print.
pages/foreman/model.js: The Foreman's model: shop settings (bays, skills), the shop day, techs (skills, shift, time off, hours), what a job needs and which bay fits, the floor, back-again trucks, clocks, Needs action, cleared today, findings, QC.
pages/foreman/page.js: The Foreman page: the header, Needs action on the left, the selected RO on top of the floor, Techs, Yard, Tomorrow (the plan and the handoff note), search.
pages/foreman/popovers.js: The Foreman's pop-overs: Assign (candidates, capacity), Bring in, Decide, Snooze, shop settings, bay types.
pages/foreman/actions.js: Doing things on the Foreman page: set status, assign, route, done, snooze, nudge, accept; fmAct handles clicks; typing, keys and dragging.
pages/foreman/floor-extras.js: On the floor (Parsec 10): drag a truck to a free bay or Move truck, the bay that fits, how long a blocker has waited, the tech's day before you assign, the readiness count.
pages/foreman/quick-peek.js: The RO quick peek on the Foreman floor: hover or Tab to a bay for the truck, complaint and who has it.
pages/foreman/shift-handover.js: The shift handover sheet from the Foreman header: pick the ROs, add a note, build it.
pages/triage/yard-map.js: Triage's yard map: TY_CAT (arrival → released, the categories), tyCat(ro), late, where a truck is.
pages/triage/model.js: Triage's model: icons and groups, small helpers (tgNum, roShortNo — an RO goes by its last 4 digits), who has an RO and for how long, ETA from the contact log, late, people and text templates, clashes, Needs action.
pages/triage/page.js: The Triage page: header, Needs action on the left, the log form (shared with the Inbox composer), approvals with a record, the Inbox / Desk / Yard views.
pages/triage/popovers.js: Triage's pop-overs: release, free spots, search; the sample trucks from the catalog sit beside them.
pages/triage/transfer-roadtest-checks.js: Transfer step by step, the road test and the truck checks (12.1), from any page (12.2): TRX pop-overs, who is in each department, the checks, the Needs action cards for them.
pages/triage/actions.js: Doing things on Triage: tgDo for every action, nudge, accept, snooze, settle, release; tgAct handles clicks; typing, ticking, keys and dragging; the selected RO's stage progress.
pages/warranty/claims-model.js: Claims basics: the warranty claim statuses (WC_ST), the operations that are claims, opStory, when an operation was done or reopened.
pages/warranty/model.js: The Warranty page's model: settings (filing days…), dates, a claim's status / amounts / due days, Waiting on Volvo, failed parts, Needs action, money, the sample set.
pages/warranty/page.js: The Warranty page: header, Needs action on the left, the selected RO, Claims, Board, Money, the failed-parts shelf.
pages/warranty/popovers.js: The Warranty page's pop-overs and the payment statement.
pages/warranty/actions.js: Doing things on Warranty: snooze, set a claim's stage, copy / upload / print / export the packet, the payment statement match; waAct handles clicks; typing and keys; viewWarranty.
pages/assets/sample-fleet.js: The sample fleet for the Assets page (asSampleFleet).
pages/assets/_open.js: Opens the Assets page closure (ASPG): every truck anyone in the shop has worked on.
pages/assets/assets-page.js: The Assets page: one row per truck, visits and repeats, the pane for one truck with its history.
pages/assets/view.js: viewAssets() and asOpenFor(): the page module's entry and opening a truck from elsewhere.
clock/day-clock.js: The day clock (shifts): clock in when the day starts, out when it ends; lunch off the clock; shiftsForDate, openShift.
clock/punch-owners.js: Each person keeps their own clocks (12.7): punchOwner / shiftOwner, the running punches of one person, the one-time migration of old punches.
clock/change-running-clock.js: Change a clock while it runs (12.7 e): move the running punch to another job, stop it at a typed time, the shift's limits.
clock/day-clock-watch.js: The day clock watches for you, on every page (14.6 G): “Still on the clock?” after the shift end, a job running before the clock-in, the clock-out check — corner cards drawn by v146Tick.
clock/lunch-reminder.js: The lunch reminder (14.7 C): a corner card at lunch time; nothing is clocked out by itself.
clock/reminders-only.js: The clock only reminds (Parsec 15 B): lunch and end-of-day reminders, snoozed 15 minutes; nothing stops or clocks out by itself.
clock/quick-time-adjust.js: Quick time adjust for a selected punch: snap, nudge, trim to neighbours, undo.
clock/air-and-lunch-blocks.js: Air and lunch blocks on the day: a deleted time entry stays as air and says what it was (15 C), who wrote a note, the air reason as a note.
clock/move-time.js: Move a person's time to someone else (12.5): for the days you pick, one person's punches become another's, with the dialog and the audit line.
automations/watcher.js:
Automations + change history: one watcher for every change wherever it was made — autoSnap keeps the last saved snapshot, autoRun compares at save, records history (autoHist) and raises events the rules listen to.
Flow: scheduleSave → autoRun(before, after) → rules → actions (status moves, Inbox notes).
automations/rules.js: The rules: a rule's context (autoCtx), conditions (autoCondOk), evaluating and applying actions (autoEvaluate / autoApplyActs), AUTO_BUILTINS (the built-in automations with their switches).
automations/built-ins.js: The six built-ins of 16.2 (parts in → tell the tech, waiting on the customer, ready to release, ask before starting without the part, past the quote, warranty claims) with their thresholds, who gets told, the What ran log with Undo, and the Automations page.
automations/sentence-builder.js: A custom rule reads as a sentence (16.2 B): When [event] [qualifier] and [detail is] [value] then [action] to [value]; the builder's chips and keyboard, the test run over the last 7 days, save.
settings/settings-page.js: One Settings page (16.2 C): the groups (Me · The shop · People & access · Data · Automations · Shortcuts), the old places that link in (SG_OLD), small helpers the registry's rows use.
settings/registry.js:
The registry: SG_REG, every setting as one row — id, group, label, help, who may change it, where it applies, get / set, default. sgReg() is what other areas call to add one.
Flow: the page draws from SG_REG; a change goes through sgChange (values-and-changes.js).
settings/shop-buttons.js: Shop buttons by department (16.3 C): the table in Settings → The shop (STATE.shopBtns), v163ShopOk(ro, act) that every shop button asks, the department label on the truck card.
settings/values-and-changes.js: Values, defaults and who: sgVal / sgDef / sgChanged, who may change a setting (sgCan / sgWho), and sgChange — every change goes through here (before and after, the Recently changed log with Undo, the save). Also going to a setting and search.
settings/draw-and-actions.js: Drawing the Settings page (groups, rows, Recently changed, search results), its actions, and the person pop-over's Size / Tooltips / Theme rows (pxProfileView).
phone/phone-view.js: The phone view (9.6): the same Parsec laid out for a phone — the bottom bar, tabs per role, More; pmAfter fixes the layout after a render.
phone/phone-sync.js: Phone sync by QR codes, no network: send the open ROs to the phone (mobBundle), read its codes back (mobApply), the sync window.
phone/sync-v2.js: Phone sync v2 (Parsec Mobile 3): spare codes, tasks per technician, what is pending for the phone (TQP).
sample/sample-data.js: The 25 sample ROs (one button in Settings → Your data): each a scenario that exercises something; loadSample25 builds them with a seeded random; clearAll.
sample/history.js: Six weeks of finished work behind the 25 sample ROs, so the Time Log, Career and Manager have history.
sample/sample-trucks.js: Sample trucks from the catalog: a real Volvo body built that year, per sample RO.
boot/init.js: Boot: theme, device, the folder (restoreFolder → FS_READY), the first render, the timers and the window listeners. Last in the manifest on purpose.
boot/dev-tools.js: Developer readouts (off by default, localStorage tec_devtools) and v161Clean, which removes the localStorage keys of the work tools Parsec 16.1 retired, once.
kit/version.js:
The version line shown on Settings → Data and written into every export and layout.json. Change it with every release (docs/CONVENTIONS.md → Releasing).
BUILD_WAS keeps the previous line so a folder written by the version before can be told apart.
library/codes.js: Fault codes in every form (P105E, P1050 FTB 17, 3226/2, MID 128 PID 110 FMI 0): reading what was typed, the label and chip text, what a code means from the Library or the built-in J1939 list.
library/read-docs.js: Reading a document: its kind from its number (CBR, TSB, FSB, Recall, Procedure), number, release, date, title, function group, model, model years, the codes it mentions, a DTC bulletin’s code table with FTBs, and an Impact procedure’s steps, warnings, tools and torques; Volvo’s function groups.
library/read-files.js: Reading a file for the Library: a PDF’s text and where each piece sits on the page (pdf.js), a screenshot through the built-in reader.
library/store.js: The Library’s records and files: STATE.libDocs / libCodes / libRules, the files in Parsec Data/Library/<kind>/, adding without doubles, and documents on an RO’s operations (op.docs) with a copy in Attachments.
library/intake.js: Filing a document, always asked first: libIntake reads each file, shows what was found to check or change, then files it in the Library and, from an RO, links it to the operation.
library/viewer.js: A document open in a panel beside the page (libOpen): its facts, the PDF, Open in a tab; a procedure’s steps ticked from its operation; on Warranty, the documents per operation and the claim folder.
pages/library/library-page.js: The Library page: tabs (Fault codes, CBRs, TSBs, FSBs, Recalls, Models, Procedures), the search, the function-group filter, documents in Impact’s columns by function group, procedures with sortable columns, codes by module with their FTBs, adding by button or drop.
pages/library/view.js: viewLibrary() and libOpenFor(): the page module’s entry and opening it narrowed to an RO and operation.
ro-page/library-on-ro.js: The Library on the RO page: each operation’s codes, function group and documents, what each code means, the documents that cover its codes (Attach / Not now), the documents strip above the operations, and PDFs offered to the Library before they attach.
library/models.js: The Library’s Models tab: the truck pictures moved out of Settings, one row per model (Make, Model, Years, Body, Open ROs) with the view from above, Replace and Remove; the catalog and Add a picture.
pages/manager/fleets-page.js: The Fleets page (its own page since 17.1, on the Manager’s engine): every fleet in a list, a pane with Overview, Trucks and ROs, the period, printing for an account review.
ro-page/steady-redraw.js: The RO page redraws without flicker (17.1): an opening plays only for what is new, a picture already showing stays, a scrolled box keeps its scroll.
ro-page/cause-correction.js: The Time tab's Cause and Correction (17.3): the two lines beside the notes, the notes underlined amber or green, click a sentence to move it, ask after a hand edit, ✦ suggests, copy the story.
ro-page/rail-fold.js: Folding the RO page's right column (17.3): a fold button at its top, a strip of icons when folded (a click opens it at that part), the \ key, remembered per page, folds by itself under 1 100 px.
ro-page/messages-chat.js:
Messages below the operations (17.2; the Customer tab left in 17.3): the RO's messages as a chat (bubbles or lines, To and @ for anyone in the shop, files and the operation, a seen dot, quick lines by role).
Flow: ropBuild puts ropMC() below Operations; sending goes through IB.send and redraws.
themes/more-themes.js: Thirteen more themes (17.3): cool blues, indigo, violet, steel, carbon and four grid backgrounds, each one line you can delete.
library/read-more.js: More from a document (17.3): its part numbers, labor operations and hours, chassis ranges, symptoms and the repair in one line; the two likeliest kinds when the number doesn't say; the fields worth checking; and using them on an operation.
library/intake-list.js: Filing a stack of files (17.3): a progress window while they read, then one list with each file's kind, number and whether it's ready, needs a check or is already in the Library; open a row to check it, or file the ready ones in one click.
pages/library/shop-and-cards.js: The Library page (17.3): For the shop (the documents that fit the open ROs), the bar by kind and what needs you, one search across every kind, the truck filter, To check, the document cards with older releases folded, and the panel opened by pointing at a row.
library/viewer-use.js: The document panel's use (17.3): what it's valid for, its symptoms and repair steps to tick from an operation, Attach to… with the ROs it fits first, and the expand button that makes the panel a page of its own.
clock/clock-edit.js: Change a day clock’s clock in or clock out on any day (17.5): its limits, the punches a new time leaves outside (trim or block), the change marked edited, deleting a clock segment.
pages/timelog/clock-rows.js: The Time Log’s clock rows (17.5): click a clock in / out time to change it — typed, suggested times and a time wheel, a reason, trims the punches outside; drag the IN / OUT flags; the row’s ⋯ menu.
import/new-ro/asist-tables.js: ASIST's Operations and Parts tables copied from the browser (17.5): each row read as a stream of cells under the header's columns, so the boxes the copy puts on lines of their own land in the right column; ASIST's buttons and notes skipped.
import/new-ro/parts-list.js: Parts pasted on their own into an RO (17.5): a Parts list of its own — ticks, cells to change, a menu on each row for the operation, Add that keeps the window open and marks each row Added.
pages/library/kits.js: The Library’s Accessory kits tab (17.5): software kit numbers for standard changes — the list and the kit beside it, search and group chips, Copy, Add to an RO…, New kit, Paste a list; changing the list is the l.kits permission.
